title: World Bloom — Dear My Fellows — Episode8 A Stage Full of Smiles

meta.Episode: Episode8 — A Stage Full of Smiles
meta.Event Outline: Having trained with three famous troupes, Wonderlands×Showtime has certainly grown. While checking for any changes in their SEKAI, they hear of a problem with the tree, and are shown a world where they are each chasing their own dreams.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_wonder_op4
Phoenix Wonderland
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's the schedule we currently have leading up to our next show!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Thank you for that. I didn't see any major problems.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: However, considering the show's story, we may want to work out how to use the stage devices sooner rather than later...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right! The director also told me about some things that he wants to try out...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I believe we should consider bringing in some new equipment for this show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll have to figure out how to work that into our budget...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I plan on doing everything I can to make sure our show makes all the guests smile!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I see. If discussions with the staff are coming along, then it sounds like we have nothing to worry about...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: That just leaves you having to talk to our stage manager.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Anyway, Otori, I'm counting on you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, I promise to do my best!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Hehe☆
Sakurako said she's counting on me!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (She was so worried when I first told her that I'd be running things...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But it feels like I'm slowly gaining her trust.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I can't let my guard down and start acting all loosey-goosey!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I still have a lot of meetings left at the other stages, so I have to keep doing my best...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I need to do everything I can since Keisuke and Shosuke gave me this opportunity to run Phoenix Wonderland's stages!
A few months earlier
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys are really gonna let me run the stages at Phoenix Wonderland...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yes, but it's not like we're going to immediately let you run everything. It'll be a step-by-step process.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Obviously, we still have the final say and bear ultimate responsibility...
But some experience running stages should benefit you in the future.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My future...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Ever since your friends left Phoenix Wonderland, you've been following us around and saying, “I wanna learn more about management and stuff”...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Shadowing someone is one way to learn, but experiencing what actually happens on the ground is also important for operators and managers.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
And you have an incredibly creative mind.
As the park's operators, we're happy to make use of such an asset.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Exactly. We think we can trust you with this, provided you have the drive. So, what do you say...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I wanna do it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna learn as much as I can about management to help make my dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
To make your dream come true...
Yes, we had a feeling you'd say that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe... I actually made a really important realization while watching you guys work.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I honestly didn't know just how much thought and effort went into getting someone else to smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I thought I knew how hard that was...
But I realize now that my understanding was poor.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I wanna do this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In order to make people all around the world smile, I'll start by filling the stages at Phoenix Wonderland with lots and lots of joy...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
We understand how you feel.
So, we'll do what we can on our end.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Again, we'll still have final say on what happens in the park.
So, you should come up with ideas for making everybody smile the way you always do.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, I will!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm gonna let the others know right away...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You mean Tenma and them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! They're all working super hard towards making their dreams come true, so I wanna tell them that I'm doing the same!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I see...
I take it that means they're each doing well in their new environments?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They are!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, Keisuke, Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for doing all this for me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I promise to do my very best!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be expecting good results...
se_walk_women_006_1

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Towards making their dreams come true, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: They're still high schoolers, so I feel like they should be stopping to smell the flowers a little more.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Even when they decided to disband their troupe, they didn't come ask for our advice until everything was basically set in stone.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: In any case, we should support Emu however we can when it comes to giving her opportunities to learn more about business management.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Since that should help her make her dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Alright, let's go with the budget and casting plan we outlined during the meeting we just had...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! I'll come up with a schedule for auditions to fill out the cast and let you know once it's finished!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Understood.
Then, I'll be waiting to hear from you.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm almost done with the stage inspections and meetings I had scheduled!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(All that's left is the Wonder Stage.
They should be doing a show right now...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, in that case...
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Big Bear
rows.Line:
*Sob*
“Everybody keeps running away because they're so scared of me...”

rows.Speaker: Big Bear
rows.Line: “But I guess that's natural since I look so big and scary... I'm never going to be able to make any friends...”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “That's not true. I'm sure everyone will become your friends once they understand what you're really like. I mean, I've never met someone kinder than you! Also...”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “At the very least, I consider you my friend.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (They're all sparkling today too... In particular...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The boy playing the protagonist, Shiratori, has really been on a roll lately☆ I know he's been practicing a lot...!)

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: The guy playing the main character's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
I'm actually a huge fan of his.
I've gotta get more great pictures of him today!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “Don't worry! They might be crying or feeling angry now, but I know a way to get them to become your friends.”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “You just need to do a happy dance for them!”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
“Come on, everyone, join us!
You can even take the hands of the people next to you!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds like fun...!
Let's try, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
This is a little embarrassing...
But, umm... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Wow...! They look like they're all having so much fun☆)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The kids and the grown-ups. Their eyes are all sparkling.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The crowd and everybody on stage are all smiling!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (This is so great...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (This reminds me of when we...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I have to keep at it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and the others played a huge role in saving this place. So...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Moving forward, I have to do absolutely everything I can to keep it going...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Especially with how hard the new troupe here is working...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm going to fill this park with smiles and laughter that spreads out to the entire world...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I've gotta keep doing more and more to make that happen.)
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone☆
You guys put on another super duper wonderhoy performance today!

rows.Speaker: Wonder Stage Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Hello, Ms. Otori.
We didn't realize that you were watching!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I was actually dancing along with you guys backstage towards the end there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really wish I could see you all perform at that other venue this weekend...

rows.Speaker: Wonder Stage Cast Member A
rows.Line: Haha. It is a bit far away.

rows.Speaker: Wonder Stage Cast Member B
rows.Line: But we promise to do our best to make the audience smile when we're over there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Great! I'll be rooting for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Wonder Stage Cast Member B
rows.Line: Thank you! Anyway, if you'll excuse us...
se_walk_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, that's it for all my on-site jobs! Now I need to go back and meet with Keisuke and Shosuke about...)
se_walk_men_001_3
Ms. Otori...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Shiratori?
Did you forget something?

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line:
No, it's not that.
I was actually hoping to discuss something with you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Discuss something?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(He seems really nervous...
This reminds me of—)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can tell me whatever it is that's on your mind!

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Umm...

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: I'm thinking about leaving the Wonder Stage.
